references.text: This verse contains the original instruction from God to make twenty boards for the second side of the tabernacle, facing north. Exodus 36:25 describes the execution of this command.
These verses describe the construction of the first side of the tabernacle and provide context for the work on the second side described in verse 25.
The entire passage gives God's detailed instructions for the tabernacle's boards and framework, which Bezalel and the craftsmen followed exactly in chapter 36.
The Merarite Levites were given responsibility for the tabernacle's boards on the north side, showing the continued importance of this part of the sanctuary.
Both verses describe components in the construction of the north wall during the execution phase.
Complementary descriptions of the north wall and its reinforcements in the same building process.
